description: Resource monitoring and auto-scaling configuration for self-healing agent

auto_scale.description: If true, automatically resize DigitalOcean droplet when resources are critical

runaway_process.description: Kill processes using >50% CPU for >10 minutes

droplet_sizes.description: Ordered list of droplet sizes for auto-scaling. Will upgrade to next size in list.

environment_variables_needed.DIGITALOCEAN_API_TOKEN: Your DigitalOcean API token for droplet management
environment_variables_needed.DIGITALOCEAN_DROPLET_ID: The ID of your droplet (find via: doctl compute droplet list)
environment_variables_needed.description: Set these env vars to enable auto-scaling

notes: Auto-scaling requires brief downtime (~1-2 min) as droplet must power off to resize
Set auto_scale.enabled=false to disable automatic upgrades (will still alert)
Runaway process detection helps prevent single processes from overloading system
Resource history is saved in state/self_healing_state.json for trend analysis
